dedupe_keys.name: electrified rail based energy storage code

description: Xitong Mu at Zhejiang University publishes code and inputs for evaluating electrified rail-based energy storage, ERES. The September 2026 Zenodo software archive contains MATLAB capacity calculations and a SWITCH configuration with model extensions. Its repository documents 2,688 separately distributed timetable cases and 315 power-system scenarios covering China, Europe and India. Outputs include charging and discharging capacities and energy-storage capacity. The ERES capacity code is MIT-licensed and freely downloadable; bundled SWITCH components retain their own notices. The documented toolchains require MATLAB, YALMIP and licensed Gurobi for capacity calculations, and Python, Pyomo and Gurobi for SWITCH runs. Related catalogue model-switch supplies the underlying energy-planning model. This configured extension can test rail–electricity coupling in transition simulations. Field-validation accuracy and transferability to other timetables remain unknown. No code or input archives were downloaded or run.
